summary: The bad() entry point used DES, a broken 56-bit block cipher (CWE-327). I replaced DES with AES (128-bit) for the key generator, key spec, and cipher while preserving the encrypt-and-print-hex behavior for the same input.

edits.old:
SecretKeySpec secretKeySpec = new SecretKeySpec(byteKey, "DES");
            Cipher desCipher = Cipher.getInstance("DES");
edits.new:
SecretKeySpec secretKeySpec = new SecretKeySpec(byteKey, "AES");
            Cipher desCipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES");
